surface_latch.setting_condition: GPU wait command kinds1/8/10: after completion indication, readGPU_BASE+58; bit26 set triggers writeGPU_BASE+1214=01000000, readGPU_BASE+1200, pollbit26clear, then set surface latch1.
surface_latch.meaning: Observed GPU exceptional-condition flag used for lower-quality redraw; exact physical register-bit name and resource cause remain unproven.
surface_latch.software_boundary: A synchronous software renderer need not invent the original GPU exception. Record an initially zero per-surface latch and read-clear it; any unsupported/failed software operation must still stop or report its actual error rather than being converted into query success.

internal_mode_control.limits: Other command kinds do not use this gate. Do not indiscriminately skip every graphics API if the latch is set. The setter also passes through native VG preparation64d2e7c; software synchronous execution must retain its own ordering.
